items.title: Prepare driveford.net preview-build admission packet
items.summary: Driveford.net is a scaffold with no verified audience brief, launch-readiness artifact, configured analytics, or site-specific content/file evidence. Create one bounded repository and preview inspection packet so the smallest safe homepage build can be admitted without inventing telemetry or publishing.
items.requested_action: Inspect the existing driveford.net scaffold and produce a dated implementation packet identifying the exact homepage entry file, stylesheet, asset locations, available routes, current metadata, build command, preview URL or local preview path, and unresolved owner/legal/security/analytics gates. Define the next engineer task: implement only a preview-only homepage and metadata pass in the identified files; do not deploy or publish.
